description: Locate, approach, and eliminate a hostile mob using a melee weapon.
preconditions: Equip a melee weapon. Identify a target mob in the immediate area.
sub_tasks: Rotate the camera to center the target and move forward to close the distance.
Maintain the crosshair on the target while staying within striking range.
Press attack repeatedly until the target is defeated, adjusting for knockback.
key_action_patterns: attack (repeatedly when crosshair is on target)
